description.name: yayatohTrigger
description.subtitle: ={{$parameter["events"].join(", ")}}
description.description: Starts the workflow when Yayatoh sends a webhook (generated from /v1 0.2.0).

options.name: An event was archived
options.description: It is hidden from lists; its data is kept. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

options.name: An event was cancelled
options.description: Refunds follow the organizer’s policy (`order.refunded` per order). `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

options.name: An event was marked as completed
options.description: It is over; reports are final. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

options.name: An event was created (new, duplicated or from a template)
options.description: The event starts as a draft. `profile` is its kind (concert, gala, conference…).

options.name: One date of a recurring event was cancelled
options.description: `startsAt` is when the cancelled date was due to start.

options.name: An event was postponed
options.description: The date is to be announced; ticket holders keep their tickets. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

options.name: An event was published
options.description: It is on sale and visible according to its visibility. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

options.name: A postponed event has a new date
options.description: Read the event for its new `startsAt`. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

options.name: An event was taken offline
options.description: It went back to draft; its page and sales are closed. `from` and `to` are the event’s status before and after.

options.name: An event’s details changed
options.description: `fields` names what changed (for example `startsAt`); read the event for the new values.

options.name: A registration form was submitted
options.description: The answers are never in the payload; they stay in the console. `formVersion` is the form version answered.

options.name: A dispute was decided
options.description: A lost dispute cancels the order’s live tickets.

options.name: A buyer disputed a payment (chargeback)
options.description: Evidence can be submitted from the console before the provider’s deadline.

options.name: An unpaid order expired and released its tickets
options.description: The checkout hold ran out before payment; the held tickets went back on sale.

options.name: An order was paid and its tickets issued
options.description: Sent once per order when payment completes (online, at the box office, by invoice, or a free order). `via` says how it was paid. Read the order and its tickets with `GET /v1/orgs/{org}/orders/{orderId}`.

options.name: A payment attempt for an order failed
options.description: The buyer can try again until the order expires.

options.name: All or part of an order was refunded
options.description: Sent for each refund. `fully` is true when nothing is left to refund; `tickets` counts the tickets the refund cancelled.

options.name: An event’s agenda was published
options.description: `agendaVersion` increases with each publish; read the agenda from the public content API.

options.name: An attendee rated an event
options.description: `rating` is 1 to 5. The review text is not in the payload.

options.name: A survey was answered
options.description: The answers stay in the console; the payload says which survey and invitation.

options.name: A ticket type was archived
options.description: It is no longer sold; tickets already issued stay valid.

options.name: A ticket type was added to an event
options.description: Read it with `GET /v1/orgs/{org}/events/{eventId}/ticket-types`.

options.name: A ticket type changed
options.description: `fields` names what changed (for example `priceMinor`).

options.name: A scan was undone
options.description: Door staff reversed an admission (a mistaken scan); the ticket can be scanned again.

options.name: A ticket was scanned in
options.description: `day` is the event day in the event’s time zone. `offline` is true when a door device scanned without a connection and synced later.

options.name: A distributed ticket was claimed by its guest
options.description: Sent when someone opens a claim link and takes the ticket.

options.name: A ticket moved to a new holder
options.description: The previous QR code stops working; `rev` is the ticket’s new revision. The new holder’s details are not in the payload.

options.name: Tickets were cancelled in bulk
options.description: One message per bulk cancellation (`operationId`) or per voided invoice (`orderId`: M5.1d pay later), with the ids of the tickets it voided. Exactly one of `operationId` and `orderId` is present.

options.name: Someone joined an event’s waitlist
options.description: Who joined is not in the payload.

options.name: A waitlist entry was offered a place
options.description: `offer` counts the offers this entry has had (1 for the first).
